notes.why_sheet_8: Sparsest OPEN100 sheet (71 raw SAHI predictions, lowest of all 12, measured before picking). 102 total nodes vs 155 (sheet 0) / 236 (sheet 10). Inferred-edge ratio 0.47 -- a MOSTLY-TRACED regime, unlike the majority-inferred sheets 0 (0.79) and 10 (0.65). Only 5 distinct tag functions (narrowest vocabulary of the three). 0 vessel nodes (same production-pipeline limitation). cls_name='check_valve' is genuinely present here (2 instances) -- flips the role it played on sheets 0/10, where it was always the intentionally-absent example.

questions.question: Find all valves whose tag mentions '1114'.

computed_facts.note: valve nodes never carry a tag field; MOV 1114 is real but belongs to an instrument (sym_46), not a valve

questions.verify: 2-way AND, empty half -- legitimate: node_type=valve alone (14 matches) and tag_contains='1114' alone (1 match) are each non-empty; only the combination is empty.

questions.question: Find instrument_bubble instruments with an MOV tag.
questions.verify: 2-way AND, present half -- STRICT: cls_name='instrument_bubble' alone gives 11 matches, tag_function='MOV' alone gives 5 (RO10 members included), the combination gives exactly these 2. Dropping either filter changes the answer -- this is the real M/C-bug test.

questions.question: Find valves of class check_valve with an MOV tag.

computed_facts.note: check_valve is a REAL, present cls_name here (2 instances) -- unlike sheets 0/10 where it was always absent -- but valves still never carry a tag field regardless of cls_name, so this is still empty

questions.verify: 2-way AND, empty half -- legitimate: cls_name='check_valve' alone (2 matches) and tag_function='MOV' alone (5 matches) are each non-empty; only the combination is empty. Tests that a genuinely-present cls_name doesn't cause a false positive on the tag constraint.
